card.fact_statement: On 3 August 2024, coordinators of the Students Against Discrimination announced a one-point demand for the resignation of the Prime Minister.
card.source_span: On 3 August 2024, coordinators of the Students Against Discrimination announced a one-point demand for the resignation of the Prime Minister and her cabinet

target_qa_variants.question: À quelle date les coordinateurs des Étudiants contre la discrimination ont-ils annoncé une revendication en un point pour la démission du Premier ministre ?
target_qa_variants.source_span: On 3 August 2024, coordinators of the Students Against Discrimination announced a one-point demand for the resignation of the Prime Minister and her cabinet
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'Students Against Discrimination' to 'Étudiants contre la discrimination' as commonly used in French media for the 2024 Bangladesh protests. 'One-point demand' translated as 'revendication en un point'.

backtranslation_en.question: On what date did the coordinators of Students Against Discrimination announce a one-point demand for the resignation of the Prime Minister?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The French translation accurately preserves the entity, relation, and expected answer of the source QA without adding new constraints.
